name: Dengue
homeCareTips: Monitor for warning signs like bleeding or severe abdominal pain
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate care if you notice bleeding, persistent vomiting, or severe abdominal pain.

name: Malaria
homeCareTips: Take prescribed antimalarials only after diagnosis
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate care if fever is very high or you experience confusion.

name: Migraine
homeCareTips: Rest in a dark, quiet room
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate care for a sudden, severe headache unlike any before, or with vision changes.

name: Seasonal Influenza
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate care for difficulty breathing or chest pain.

name: Gastroenteritis
homeCareTips: Avoid dairy and oily food temporarily
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate care for signs of severe dehydration or blood in stool.
